premises.text: After-school private tutoring is essential but hard to source
premises.evidence_span: Private tutoring is a standard for success

premises.text: Peer tutors are booked through preference filters and instant chat/location sharing
premises.evidence_span: Select a tutor based on your preferences, number of hours tutored, proximity

premises.text: Online delivery includes whiteboard, notes, video, ratings, and progress reports
premises.evidence_span: Once a session is done, a student rates the tutor. And as soon as the session is done, after that, he receives a progress report

premises.text: Algorithms pre-select and recommend tutors using a graph of students, tutors, and interactions
premises.evidence_span: We use our graph database to connect students, tutors, and their interactions to show personalized recommendations in real time

premises.text: Revenue comes from tutor commissions and institutional analytics subscriptions
premises.evidence_span: We charge our tutors a 20% commission per transaction

value.text: Make private tutoring accessible via a peer marketplace

causal_links.evidence_span: Need a private tutor for exam tomorrow?
We're also going to charge the institutions

notes: v1.3.1: commission and institutional fee kept in one commercial premise describing how the platform is sold. Ministry MOUs treated as traction/channel evidence, not a premise.
